**rule-status values:**

- `excluded` — removed from the active ruleset by an explicit `[rules."id"]` entry in `exclusions.toml`; the PR# is where that decision was made. Every exclusion is listed individually — nothing is dropped implicitly, so a new upstream rule can never be silently excluded (it appears as `new` for triage instead).
- `active` — present in the ruleset but explicitly recorded in `exclusions.toml` (a deliberate keep decision).
- `new` — present in the snapshot with no recorded decision yet; triage it into `exclusions.toml`.
